column1: # One line per pilot who has a painted face in docs/faces/, written by
# tools/chronicle-art.sh the one time it asked about them and read by
# tools/chronicle.sh into every place their name appears. This line is the
# lock, and it is a firmer one than the plates have: a pilot with a line
# here is never asked about again, file or no file, flag or no flag. There
# is no --force and no --prune for a face. See the top of the script.

column3: A pilot in a space suit, seeded from the name and asked for once.
